title: What is phone fraud?
body:
What is phone fraud?

Phone scammers call and deceive people:
• "Hello, this is the bank! Your account is blocked, tell me your password"
• "This is the police! Your son has problems, we need money"
• "Congratulations! You won a million! Transfer 5000₽ to receive"

Remember: NEVER tell passwords over the phone!

✅ ALADDIN checks a call recording after the conversation and helps assess risk.
